description: Zero‑dependency, TypeScript‑first Node.js framework that blends Express simplicity, Fastify speed, and built‑in AI‑driven edge routing.
npm_trending_strategy: Version 0.0.156‑daily ships with AI‑enhanced routing that learns request patterns at runtime, edge‑ready adapters for Cloudflare Workers, Bun, and Deno, and native HTTP/2 + HTTP/3 support—all in a <30 KB zero‑dependency bundle. The package markets itself as the *only* Express‑style API that delivers Fastify‑grade throughput while giving developers AI‑powered route optimization and built‑in observability out of the box, hitting the 2026 trends of GenAI, edge‑compute, and serverless‑first architectures.
download_hooks: Sub‑millisecond request routing thanks to AI‑guided path selection that adapts to traffic patterns.
Zero‑dependency, <30 KB footprint ensures lightning‑fast cold starts on serverless and edge platforms.
Type‑safe, ESM‑only API feels like Express but runs at Fastify speed, with built‑in telemetry and observability.
